verdict.decision_rule: SAFETY_DISCHARGED only if every obligation in the mechanism has an explicit validity contract, every required precondition is established by its callers at the candidate, and no safe interface can cause UB. OWNERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTED only if a safe ownership model exists and the residual boundary is identified without an unestablished caller precondition. Otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED.
verdict.statement: The §7 criterion-3 whole-closure safety argument is NOT ESTABLISHED at b78c. The b78c closures are ACCEPTED and discharge 290/290 obligations at the tool's site level, but only 65 of the 290 obligations were independently re-read at b78; the remaining 225 are bound by an operation-span content hash whose own claim_scope excludes caller closures. 57 sites carry only an operation-level SAFETY block and no fn-level # Safety. The two mechanisms with UNSAFE_OPEN state (C_ABI_CONTRACT, BIO) are not mechanism-wide. No Miri/ASan/TSan/Loom/dudect run supports any mechanism. This verdict is consistent with evidence/b78-assurance-adjudication.json (NOT ESTABLISHED) and CAMPAIGN-STATUS ('no mechanism is discharged mechanism-wide').

residuals.statement: The argument is not established: 225/290 obligations rest on caller closures not re-established at bb7d5206a, and the closure's span hash explicitly excludes caller closures.
57 sites in the b78 review cohort have only an operation-level SAFETY block and no fn-level # Safety (R-BLOCKLEVEL-CONTRACT); the census classifies them uncontracted.
No Miri (Stacked/Tree Borrows), ASan, TSan, Loom, dudect or ctgrind run supports the candidate; every review verdict is source-and-static-control.
C_ABI_CONTRACT and BIO are UNSAFE_OPEN mechanism-wide; SSL_SESSION retains external serialisation; RUNTIME_CONCURRENCY's B60 adjudication is by the orchestrating agent, not an independent reviewer.
No secret-cleansing audit and no panic-safety/failure-atomicity evidence for the stateful contexts; both are §5/§4 obligations, not documentation items.

The digest_impl! macro body contains 5 unsafe extern C fns without # Safety (dupctx, internal_init, internal_final, update, get_params) that are not in the 65-site reviewed cohort; whether the inventory's macro attribution accounts for them is not established by this argument.

non_claims: This argument does not promote the candidate to SAFE_COMPATIBLE; safe_compatible remains false.

The per-mechanism NOT_ESTABLISHED verdict does not assert that any site is unsafe; it asserts that the §7 criterion-3 argument is not established at this candidate.
The 153 contract-bounded element-7 sites are intentionally target-unbounded by public ABI; contract-bounded is criterion 2, not criterion 3.
No constant-time, secret-cleansing or runtime-UB claim is made.
